name: Solar Panel Operating Temperature
description: Temperature of the solar array during sunlit orbit phases. Checks whether temperature stays within panel qualification range.

elements.name: Solar Panel Peak Temperature
elements.description: Peak equilibrium temperature of the solar array in worst-case orbit. Uncertain due to coating degradation and albedo variation.

uncertainty.source: Thermal desktop analysis with orbital parameter variation

elements.name: Solar Panel Qualification Temperature
elements.description: Maximum qualification temperature from component testing

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(T_panel) = T_panel if T_panel <= T_qual, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The component qualification temperature guards the solar panel temperature uncertainty set; operation above 90°C risks cell delamination.
